comments: The signature letter is reported as "la" in [8H6M69W4], and as "ma" in [2PUVZG5F]: 46.
name: bde ba can gyi smon lam
item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs (cover page), 'khyug yig (text)
Right and left indent of decreasing size on fol. 2a, left indent of the first two lines on fol. 2b.
Post-colophon notes after the colophon on 2b8 up to 3a4, probably mantras.
